Interface IPropertyContainerConst

All Superinterfaces:
IPropertyHolderConst, Iterable<PropertyValuePair<?>>
All Known Implementing Classes:
PropertyContainer, PropertyContainerSnapshot
public sealed interface IPropertyContainerConst extends IPropertyHolderConst, Iterable<PropertyValuePair<?>> permits PropertyContainer, PropertyContainerSnapshot
Represents a read-only property container.

This interface is used to get the values of properties from a property container.

This is a specialization of IPropertyHolderConst that is used specifically for property containers.
